create.title: Goat Ribs
create.description: Goat ribs (or riblets) are a lean, flavorful, and nutrient-dense meat, lower in fat and cholesterol than beef or lamb. They are best cooked using low-and-slow methods like oven-roasting (\(150\text{--}160^{\circ }\text{C}\) for 3 hours) or braising to ensure tenderness. Key preparation involves cleaning, trimming, and marinating with garlic, ginger, and oil to enhance flavor.

create.title: Raw Goat Milk
create.description: Produced by our friends at Swiss Villa, raw milk is natures original health food and is full of beneficial proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals and enzymes that would otherwise be damaged during the pasteurization and homogenization process. It contains many bioactive compounds that are proven to strengthen your immune system. Further, raw milk is an inherently safe food, as it contains many beneficial bacteria that prevent pathogens from developing in the milk.
